:::{#exr-identity-practice}
#### Removing identity matrices from both sides of a product

Simplifying algebra with [matrices](#def-matrix) often leaves an [identity matrix](#def-identity-matrix) in a [product](#def-matrix-mult),
and @thm-identity removes it.
Let

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{2 & -1 & 0 \\ 5 & 3 & 1}.
$$

Find $\matr{I}_2\,\matr{A}\,\matr{I}_3$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Use @thm-identity once for each [identity matrix](#def-identity-matrix).

:::

:::
